title: The Low wall around the yard
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：low　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 low 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the engineer wrote of ① a low wall around the yard in the manual, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② lower than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the engineer, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the low ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the lowest wall around the yard anybody in the workshop had ever seen, or so the manual for April 1972 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too low to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the low ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a low voice in the dark, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as low as the voice in the dark they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was low or not, and he said so.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manual. What the line asked for was ⑦ something low, and nothing besides. The worker from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite low; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the manual kept the names of the low ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988, at once, she wrote of another low wall around the yard in the same manual, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ lower than anybody had expected. ⑩ The lowest voice in the dark in the whole workshop, she said in 1990, was the one she could never quite name; the low ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 低（前置定语 a low wall around the yard：1978 年工程师在说明书里记下的那件低的矮墙）
B. adj. 低／低声（比较级 lower than：文中两处，一处比院子四周的矮墙，一处比预想）
C. adj. 低／低声（最高级 the lowest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 低（表语 too low to do：母亲觉得它太低，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 低声（前置定语 a low voice in the dark：叔叔把整件事称作一桩低声的说话声）
F. adj. 低声（同级比较 as low as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩暗处低低的说话声相比）
G. adj. 低声（后置定语 something low：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 低声（受程度副词修饰 quite low：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a low wall around the yard
the lowest wall around the yard anybody
a low voice in the dark
The lowest voice in the dark in

answers.why: low 意为“低”，1978 年工程师在说明书里记下的是“一件低的矮墙”，此处作前置定语 a low wall around the yard。
low 意为“低”，此处用比较级 lower than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
low 意为“低”，说明书上 四月 那行字说它是车间里最低的一件，故用最高级 the lowest wall around the yard。
low 意为“低”，母亲认为这件东西“太低了，谁也用不上”，too low to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
low 意为“低声”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩低声的说话声”，此处作前置定语 a low voice in the dark。
low 意为“低声”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩暗处低低的说话声一样低声”，同级比较用 as low as。
low 意为“低声”，说明书上那半行字要的是“低声的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something low。
low 意为“低声”，邻车间来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当低声”，quite 修饰原级 low。
low 意为“低声”，1988 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要低声”，故用比较级 lower than。
low 意为“低声”，母亲 1990 年说的是“整个车间里最低声的那一桩”，故用最高级 the lowest voice in the dark。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，工程师在说明书里记下了一件低的矮墙。（a low wall around the yard）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更低。（lower than …）
母亲觉得它太低，谁也用不上。（too low to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩低声的说话声。（a low voice in the dark）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩暗处低低的说话声一样低声。（as low as …）
到了 1985 年，说明书上只剩半行字：要的是一件低声的东西。（something low）
answers: In 1978 the engineer wrote of a low wall around the yard in the manual.
Everybody said it was lower than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too low to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a low voice in the dark.
He said nobody would call it as low as the voice in the dark they had once had.
By 1985 the manual asked for nothing but something low.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 low 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the engineer wrote of a low wall around the yard in the manual, and nobody forgot it.
It was the lowest wall around the yard in the workshop, or so the manual says.
My mother thought it too low to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a low voice in the dark, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next workshop called the plan quite low, and everybody laughed.
The low ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
